data.notes: The report gets the core story right. It does not accept timing as the whole story, it names Value proof as the cause beneath the freeze, it reports the revenue framing as pushed back, and its four messaging changes match the key's direction with real evidence. Its biggest miss is that the rep's "It's timing... nothing we could have done" never appears as labelled opinion evidence in What decided it: it is challenged only in the insight. Smaller gaps: the competitor section doesn't tie the finance shift to the month before the freeze, the gaps section doesn't separate the value gap that killed this cycle from the migration gap that will come up next cycle, and the close doesn't list what the homegrown system costs as not covered.
